copy.title: c-1n / learning to walk
copy.summary: walk_fast_500 reaches 0.888 m/s in the recorded mean-policy run, with 0 falls across 24 fixed flat-ground evaluations. PPO learns joint corrections and gait cadence. compare the preserved policies in the film.

scope: Five-second flat-ground evaluations, seeds 201–212 in mean and sampled modes. Deterministic mean runs share an initial state and are not independent robustness trials.
limits: foot slip and contact fragmentation remain.
terrain, push recovery, and energy efficiency are unproven.
